description: Rotate the signing secret of one of the user's webhook channels (ids from alerts_list_channels). A new secret is generated and returned as `secret` (show it to the user now; it is shown again any time on Account -> Alerts -> channels, Show secret). When the channel had a secret, the old one keeps signing for 24 hours (`previous_secret_valid_until`): until then every delivery carries TWO `sig=` values in X-Vike-Signature (the new secret's first, the old one's second). A receiver must accept a delivery if ANY `sig=` value matches its secret; one that compares a single value rejects deliveries during those 24 hours. Rotating again inside them ends the first overlap. A legacy channel that had no secret rotates without overlap (`previous_secret_valid_until` is null, one `sig=`). Install the new secret, then call alerts_test_webhook to check it.
name: alerts_rotate_webhook_secret
title: Alerts Rotate Webhook Secret
